hebrewText: אַחֲרִ֤יב הָרִים֙ וּ/גְבָע֔וֹת וְ/כָל עֶשְׂבָּ֖/ם אוֹבִ֑ישׁ וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֤י נְהָרוֹת֙ לָֽ/אִיִּ֔ים וַ/אֲגַמִּ֖ים אוֹבִֽישׁ

tokens.bdb: to parch (through drought) i.e. (by analogy,) to desolate, destroy, kill
tokens.kjv: decay, (be) desolate, destroy(-er), (be) dry (up), slay, [idiom] surely, (lay, lie, make) waste.

tokens.bdb: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.enLiteralWord: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.explanation: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.explanationEn: a mountain or range of hills

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: to be ashamed, confused or disappointed; also (as failing) to dry up (as water) or wither (as herbage)
tokens.kjv: be ashamed, clean, be confounded, (make) dry (up), (do) shame(-fully), [idiom] utterly, wither (away).

tokens.bdb: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring, call (a name), care, cast in, change, charge, commit, consider, convey, determine, [phrase] disguise, dispose, do, get, give, heap up, hold, impute, lay (down, up), leave, look, make (out), mark, [phrase] name, [idiom] on, ordain, order, [phrase] paint, place, preserve, purpose, put (on), [phrase] regard, rehearse, reward, (cause to) set (on, up), shew, [phrase] stedfastly, take, [idiom] tell, [phrase] tread down, (over-)turn, [idiom] wholly, work.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.enLiteralWord: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanation: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanationEn: to put (used in a great variety of applications

tokens.bdb: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile
tokens.enLiteralWord: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile
tokens.explanation: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile
tokens.explanationEn: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile

tokens.bdb: properly, a habitable spot (as desirable); dry land, a coast, an island
a marsh; hence a rush (as growing in swamps); hence a stockade of reeds
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a marsh; hence a rush ; hence a stockade of reeds
tokens.enLiteralWord: a marsh; hence a rush ; hence a stockade of reeds
tokens.explanation: a marsh; hence a rush ; hence a stockade of reeds
tokens.explanationEn: a marsh; hence a rush ; hence a stockade of reeds
